controls.input_condition: A main-scheme UK ETS emissions or activity-level record is assigned to a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Use 1 January to 31 December as the monitoring period and store report, verification and surrender dates separately
controls.risk_prevented: Mixing scheme year with submission or transaction year

controls.input_condition: Previous-year main-scheme emissions are promoted as compliant reported emissions
controls.expected_action: Require both the annual emissions report and satisfactory verification report to be submitted through METS by 31 March
controls.risk_prevented: Publishing draft or unverified emissions as compliant values

controls.input_condition: A main-scheme installation has verified reportable emissions for the previous scheme year
controls.expected_action: Require surrender from the operator holding account of allowances equal to reportable emissions by 30 April
controls.risk_prevented: Confusing reporting completion with allowance compliance

controls.input_condition: The operator surrendered too few allowances by 30 April
controls.expected_action: Record the mandatory shortfall penalty and any later deficit notice as separate compliance events; later surrender does not erase the deadline breach
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a deficit notice or late surrender as cancellation of the penalty basis

controls.input_condition: Allowances are being transferred into an operator holding account before surrender
controls.expected_action: Apply the working-day 10:00-16:00 UK transaction window to transfers, but do not apply that window to surrender transactions
controls.risk_prevented: Blocking valid surrender or assuming transfers can complete at any time

controls.input_condition: The operator holding account is not on the supplier's trusted account list
controls.expected_action: Preserve the 24-hour transaction delay and the separate four-working-day trusted-list addition process requiring two authorised representatives
controls.risk_prevented: Assuming last-minute allowance delivery is immediate

controls.input_condition: An improvement report is required for the installation
controls.expected_action: Set a 30 June METS submission deadline and keep not-applicable installations explicitly separate
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a conditional obligation as universal or omitting a required report

controls.input_condition: A non-significant monitoring-plan change was made during the scheme year
controls.expected_action: Require regulator notification through METS by 31 December of that year

controls.input_condition: A proposed monitoring-methodology-plan change is significant
controls.expected_action: Require a permit-variation application at least 14 days before modification, or as soon as reasonably practicable when advance notice is impossible
controls.risk_prevented: Implementing significant free-allocation methodology changes without approval

controls.input_condition: A free-allocation installation reports for scheme year 2026 or later
controls.expected_action: Require the standalone METS activity-level report and verification report as well as the emissions workflow, both by 31 March
controls.risk_prevented: Completing only one of two required annual workflows

controls.input_condition: The activity-level report shows a decrease or sub-installation cessation that reduces the current-year entitlement
controls.expected_action: Calculate the revised entitlement and require return of any excess free allocation already received
controls.risk_prevented: Retaining allowances no longer supported by activity levels

controls.input_condition: A free-allocation installation ceased operation during a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Require an activity-level report for its final year of operation even though operation has ended

controls.input_condition: A sub-installation reports that all operations ceased
controls.expected_action: Store cessation date and intent to resume; when resumption is intended, also store expected restart date and technical capability to resume
controls.risk_prevented: Losing the facts required to distinguish temporary inactivity from permanent cessation

controls.input_condition: An installation has ceased operation or no longer intends regulated activities to resume
controls.expected_action: Derive the surrender-application deadline from the regulator notice or the applicable one-month cessation/non-resumption rule; do not use a generic fixed calendar date
controls.risk_prevented: Late or prematurely triggered permit surrender

controls.input_condition: A surrender or revocation notice takes effect
controls.expected_action: Require a final emissions report through the effective date and surrender allowances equal to those reportable emissions
controls.risk_prevented: Closing the permit while leaving final emissions unreported or uncovered

controls.input_condition: A PRTR industrial activity code has threshold marked not applicable
controls.expected_action: Treat the activity as having no minimum activity threshold and require PRTR reporting when the other reporting conditions apply
controls.risk_prevented: Misreading not applicable as exempt from reporting
